splitDiscipline: merge gate parameters were swept on DEVELOPMENT cases only (--dev-only); held-out cases were evaluated once, after freezing.

oracleCeilings.interpretation: Selection fixes alone cap at R 0.59; the recoverable quality lives in MERGING.

endToEndPaddleBench.note: Precision +81% relative; recall −19% relative. The pipeline now claims far less and is right far more often — the wrong-player rate went 1/2 → 0/2 dual-labeled frames.

heldOutOnly.note: On never-tuned footage the surviving claims are 100% correct (5/5), but 8 of 13 visible frames are still dropped at ownership.

remainingLoss: S2b 0.96 → S3 0.48: ownership still discards half the true-paddle observations. Merging recovered ~1/3 of the gap; the rest needs ownership LABELS (2 dual-labeled frames exist), not more hand-designed weights.
provenance: Merging concatenates MEASURED detections only; gaps stay gaps; no position is invented.
